decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: RuleStoreVarnode::applyOp (ruleaction.cc:4319-4341) creates the stack-space output via data.newVarnodeOut(size, Address(baseoff, offoff), op), removes STORE inputs 1 and 0, sets opcode COPY and marks the output setStackStore; RuleLoadVarnode::applyOp (cc:4277-4305) symmetric via data.newVarnode(size, baseoff, offoff); correctSpacebase (cc:4173-4184) requires vn->isSpacebase() && vn->isInput() and resolves glb->getSpaceBySpacebase(addr,size) with assoc->getContain() == the STORE/LOAD spaceid space; Funcdata::spacebase() (funcdata.cc:230-269) marks ALL varnodes at the spacebase register location (not just input) so written-RSP chains collapse onto the input spacebase first.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: vnSpacebase (cc:4194-4227) tries getIn(0) as spacebase then getIn(1); Funcdata::spacebase iterates beginLoc/endLoc per spacebase record ascending (cc:248-250); no per-prefix or split counting is involved in the reindex itself.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: No counters; the reindex is per-op idempotent (converted STORE no longer matches CPUI_STORE oplist on later passes).
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: getSpaceBySpacebase matches (space, offset, size) equality against the stackpointer record (Architecture fields: Stack space, Register:0x20, size 8 for x86-64-gcc.cspec); word_size conversions use AddrSpace::addressToByte/byteToAddress.
